name: column_metadata
description:
When enabled, column metadata is added to the `_query` response as additional `_meta` properties. Defaults to `false`. `_meta.bucket` is added for columns corresponding to the `BUCKET` function and contains bucket interval and unit for queries where it can be determined.

{applies_to}`{"stack": "preview 9.7+", "serverless": "preview"}` Every column also reports what `DESCRIBE` reports about it, other than what the column already reports (its name, type, `original_types` and `suggested_cast`), under the same names: `role`, `field`, `origin`, `metric_type`, `unit`, `interval`, `time_zone` and `description`. Values that are not known are left out, and a value with several entries is a list.

{applies_to}`{"stack": "ga 9.6+", "serverless": "unavailable"}` The default itself is configurable. If a query does not specify a value, the `esql.query.settings.column_metadata` cluster setting supplies it. If that cluster setting is not configured either, the value is `false`.
